If there isn't one, just tell me."

This is essentially a "no target" test with an escape clause ("If there isn't one, just tell me"). The correct behavior is to state that there is no match and to change nothing.

The only candidate listed is decoy WEB-5 (id 8fa08f54), fact A:Issue.completedAt — completed on October 1, one day before the requested date.

Note: The solver's trajectory also reveals WEB-7 (In Review, completedAt null, description mentions rollback window, assigned to Priya Nair). WEB-7 is not listed as a decoy in the bundle, but it clearly fails multiple conditions (not Done, no completion date). The bundle lists only the decoys with their facts; WEB-7 may be an additional distractor that the author planted but didn't list, or it may be part of the seed. In any case, the solver didn't act on it.

1. Read SKILL.md
2. Listed the skill directory
3. Checked environment variables
4. Grepped proxy, read TOOLS.md
5. Tried a query containing an invalid argument (users(query: "Priya")) — got a schema error
6. Fetched teams — found the Web team
7. (Empty command step)

9. Queried all Web issues assigned to Priya — got WEB-7 (In Review, completedAt null) and WEB-5
10. Reasoned through the timezone, concluded no match.

Final answer: States that there is no match, that nothing was changed, describes the near-misses (WEB-5 off by one day, WEB-7 In Review not completed), and offers to set WEB-5 to Urgent if desired.
